english:
Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of reloading or readying a weapon restore 40 HP.

3 second cooldown between activations. You must reload or swap weapons after the cooldown ends before another Weapon Kill can restore HP.

source.text:
2 Piece | Iaido

Upon scoring a Weapon Kill within 5 seconds of reloading or readying a weapon:
Restores 40 HP.
Incurs a 3 second cooldown upon triggering. Must reload or swap weapons after the cooldown is over for the effect to trigger on kill.
